# Bundled Manrope font

Manrope variable font, weight axis 200–800, downloaded October 17, 2026 from the Google Fonts repository:
https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/manrope/Manrope%5Bwght%5D.ttf

The font bytes are unmodified. File renamed locally for URL simplicity.
Copyright 2018 The Manrope Project Authors. Distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; see OFL-Manrope.txt in this folder.

The application loads this file from its own origin. It makes no font-service requests.
